_doc: An EXAMPLE of ears-mail's wake rules: three placeholder seats, each showing one option. ears-mail reads the rules at ~/.sessionkit/voice/settings/wake.json (or the file its --rules names), never the example that ships in the package; to use the example, copy it to that path and rename the seats to your own, or add your own seats there with: ears wake add SEAT --names 'a|b'. Defaults, then each seat's own; a seat's names and openers are regex alternations, and its names default to its key. 'assistant' lists the sound-alikes the STT hears for its name; 'helper' must be called by name first (name_first) and lights up for 300 ms; 'reviewer' sets its own openers. A seat's key is its address's local part, WHOLE: the device mail's Ears-Rule writes KEY@host=call and the pager matches it exactly, so assistant@host=call does not wake assistant+engineer. 'again' lists the say-again phrases: a turn that is WHOLLY one (names, openers and 'sorry'/'please' stripped from its ends) replays the newest heard line of the seat it names, else of whoever spoke last, within again_window seconds, and wakes nobody; [] or false turns it off for a seat.
